description: The kit's health check with a simulated missing anchor, in a developer build of Bookmarks published with -p:KitRenameAnchors=detailButtons. As viewer: the details page loses only its Add bookmark button, the console warns once per page load, one ClientHealth report goes out and is answered 204, and the next page load doesn't report again within ten minutes. Then forged reports (unknown anchor, bad WebVersion, bad Client, an anchor on a view it isn't declared for, versions in Arabic-Indic digits, a line break in ClientVersion), a flood of valid ones and an oversized one, all sent with the page's own token: every answer is 204 except 413 for the oversized one. health-native.json and health-diagnostics.json follow (scripts/README.md).

steps.name: health probe in every document
sign in as viewer
the Bookmarks script ran
this is the developer build that renames detailButtons
forget the report time of an earlier run in this browser profile
find Long Test Movie
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Long Test Movie', Limit: 1 })).Items[0].Id

steps.name: open the details page
the details page, with the Bookmarks section in it (hidden: the viewer has no bookmarks)
the console warns: web anchor detailButtons missing on details (web 10.11.5)
the feature that needs the button row is off: no Add bookmark button, while the row itself is there
one ClientHealth report, answered 204
the report
the report carries the client fields and the one missing anchor
steps.assert: (b => b.WebVersion === '10.11.5' && b.Client === 'Jellyfin Web' && b.ClientVersion === '10.11.5' && b.Layout === 'Desktop' && b.Experimental === false && b.PluginVersion === '1.2.2.0' && b.Missing.length === 1 && b.Missing[0].Anchor === 'detailButtons' && b.Missing[0].View === 'details' && b.Missing[0].Count === 1)(__vars.report)

steps.name: one warning for the page load
the browser keeps the report time
reload the details page
the Bookmarks script ran again
the new page load warns again
but reports nothing: one report per browser every ten minutes
forged reports and a flood, with the page's own token: every answer is 204

an oversized report: 413
